deviations: KSP 2.3.12 (not kapt): the dispatch anticipated a '<kotlin>-<ksp>' version; KSP decoupled its versioning — the coupled line ended at 2.2.21-2.0.5 and the current line is 2.3.x (2.3.12 latest), which serves Kotlin 2.4.20. Verified working: ':app:kspDebugKotlin' runs the Room 2.8.5 compiler successfully. Recorded per dispatch instruction ('add whichever is current and compatible, record as deviation').

Room DAO gate runs under Robolectric 4.16 (test-only in :app, @Config(sdk=[34])) + androidx.test.ext:junit 1.3.0 + junit-vintage-engine (the JUnit4 Robolectric runner riding the project's JUnit-platform test setup). Chosen per dispatch's 'choose what works and record it': Room cannot run on the plain JVM inside an Android module (android-variant artifacts; framework SQLite is stubbed in unit tests), and Room's KMP JVM variant is not reachable from an Android application module's test classpath.

Gate types are echoed with log-owned serialization vocabularies: :core's gate module (Phase 4) has non-serializable HClass/ActionKind enums, and the phase rules forbid modifying existing code — so DecisionLogModels.kt defines LoggedHClass (@SerialName "H1".."H8", honoring vision 05 §2 'class: H1–H8') and LoggedActionKind ("tap"..) with exhaustive when-mappers from the gate types (a new gate class fails compilation, so the echo cannot silently drift).

executedAction disposition vocabulary invented (vision 05 §2 says only 'incl. refusal, gate outcomes'): executed | refused-by-owner (gate DENY) | gate-timeout (30s timeout = deny, vision 06 §2) | task-aborted (double refusal). The gate decision itself lives separately in gateEvent {class, decision: approved|denied|timeout, trustedFromTask} exactly per the vision table; trustedFromTask=true is rejected on denied/timeout rows (it can only accompany an approval).

mixedTeacher is defined as >1 distinct pinned TEACHER MODEL in the window (the pinned snapshot is the teacher of record, vision 02 §5 — two configs sharing one snapshot are one teacher); manifest.teacherPins still lists the distinct (configId, model) pairs in first-seen order for provenance.

Cross-field loud validation added per core DOX law ('cross-field inconsistencies fail loudly'): teacherAnswer chosen+distribution keys must live on questionPrimary's option ids; shadowAnswer bucket/element keys must live on questionShadow's buckets / the chosen bucket's options; shadowAnswer requires shadow; agreement fields are present iff both answers exist and agreementExactMatch must equal the stored choices' top-1; stateFormatVersion >= 1 (an ART-7 echo, deliberately not pinned to the current STATE_FORMAT_VERSION so old rows stay valid across bumps).

KL convention (documented in Agreement.kt, vision 05 §3 'KL over the shared option space'): natural log; option space = union of both distributions' keys with missing keys zero-filled; p->0 terms contribute 0 (the limit 0·ln(0/q)=0); q->0 terms floored at 1e-12 (epsilon convention — large but FINITE penalty, JSON cannot carry Infinity); inputs asserted normalized (Σp=1 within 1e-6) and in [0,1], failing loudly; identical distributions give exactly 0.0. The 1e-6 tolerance constant is shared with the DecisionLogRow validation.

questionShadow is non-nullable on every row: the bucketed form exists whenever the step happened (it is derived from the candidate list); only the shadow ANSWER is nullable (vision 05 §2 makes shadow/shadowAnswer nullable — the shadowMiss case, vision 02 §4). A shadowAnswer without a shadow ref is rejected as incoherent.

RlcdExport.export(rows) returns case-only JSONL so lines stay strictly upstream-shaped; the manifest (export timestamp, rowCount, teacherPins, mixedTeacher, stateFormatVersions) is a separate @Serializable structure with encodeManifest() — the caller composes the sidecar/last line (Phase 6/12 concern). Gold keys are sorted at export for byte-canonical corpora; state text is copied verbatim (never rewritten, vision 05 §4); export performs zero I/O (ART-8).

Room entity stores enums as their @SerialName strings and nested log objects as DECISION_LOG_JSON columns (questionPrimary/questionShadow/teacherAnswer/shadowAnswer/executedAction/gateEvent); shadow {checkpoint, precision} is denormalized into nullable columns so shadowMiss is queryable. exportSchema=false for v1 (no schema-location wiring yet); table indexed on taskId and timestamp for the two query APIs.

DecisionLogger (phase doc §6 contract name) wraps the DAO converting through the validated DecisionLogRow on every access — corrupt columns fail loudly on decode; insertAll added for batch/export-repair paths; duplicate rowId fails via OnConflictStrategy.ABORT (insert-once).

Test-side: golden snapshots are committed under core/src/test/resources/log/goldens/ (6 files) with an UPDATE_GOLDENS=true regeneration mode in the test (env var, reviewed-schema-change only); :app test fixtures deliberately mirror the :core gate fixtures because cross-module test fixtures are not visible without testFixtures wiring.
